_doc: Plays once when John is in 'level' and 'after_step' is done. Step keys: duration (ms), pos (camera centre), zoom, zoom_duration, text + text_dt (typed over ms), centered_text + centered_text_dt, image ('cutscene1' | 'black'), waiting_end, boom ([x, y]: purple shockwave there; nodes unlocked by after_step appear with it). 'then': level to travel to when it ends.

steps.centered_text: A universe where humans and monsters lived peacefully.
But on this day, the unpredictable happened...

steps.text: John: Man. What a dream.
John: I better check on her.

kitchen.after_step: Talk to Cynthia in the kitchen

steps.text: Cynthia: Hello brother.
Cynthia: You look pale. Are you alright?
John: I had a very weird nightmare.
Cynthia: Anyway.. Manos is waiting for you in the training field.
Cynthia: I'll go meet my friends at school. See you around!

training.after_step: Meet Manos at the training field

steps.text: Manos: Hey John, ready for your usual training?
John: I sure am!
Candy: *meow meow*
Manos: Grab your sword from the chest, then show me your skills on those dummies.
Manos: Good! You're getting better every day, John. I'm proud of-
The explosion tears through the air... and the souls caught in it take on physical form.
Manos: This purple aura.. It couldn't be HIM.
Manos: Shadows! Defeat them, John! I'll go get my gear.
Manos: And check on Cynthia at school, she might be in danger!
Alexia: John! Monsters kidnapped Cynthia!
Alexia: I barely managed to run away.
John: Oh no! Where did they take her?
Alexia: Shadows are guarding the gate, you can't go back that way.
Alexia: But there's an old ladder behind the trees. It leads to the caves.
Alexia: Good luck! Hopefully it won't have any monsters.
John: Well that was.. dangerous.
John: Hmm? What is that?
The Big Dummie awakens!
Manos: John! What took you so long?
John: The road was blocked, I made it through the caves.
John: The monsters took Cynthia. We have to get her back!
Manos: This aura belongs to no one else but my old nemesis.. Alcemenos.
Manos: He must be using his old base.
Manos: We must go to Porto Rafti before the sun goes down.
